scope: Conference-wide validation of output/*.json (15 room/day recordings) and of the derived files in derived/. Source files were not modified; corrections marked correction_applied=true were made only in derived/content_items.json and are also listed in each item's corrections array. A second review cleaned speaker labels, corrected evidence-supported spellings, moved recording notes out of analytical fields, and improved optional excerpts. Uncertain identities remain flagged.

severity_scale.high: Structural error that breaks references or integrity
severity_scale.medium: Likely factual/identification error; needs human review before publication
severity_scale.low: Minor extraction artefact or quality issue
severity_scale.info: Documented discrepancy; no action strictly required

checks_performed.check: All 15 source files parse as JSON and share the recording/content_items/unassigned/programme_status structure
Content item ids present and unique across the conference
Required fields and field types match json-template.json
Enumerated values (type, content_type, audience_level, confidence, programme_match, programme_status, unassigned.type)
Timestamps are HH:MM:SS, source segments have start < end and lie within the transcript length
Every claim, Q&A, notable-moment and excerpt timestamp falls inside the item's source_segments
representative_excerpt text located verbatim in the SRT transcript near its timestamp
checks_performed.detail: all excerpts found; 6 timestamps re-aligned (>10 s off)

checks_performed.check: programme_id values exist in program-data.js; no programme item linked from more than one content item (duplicate talks from recording overlap)
programme_status references valid content items; every programme item for each recorded room/day has a status

checks_performed.detail: no duplicates; similar titles are distinct talks

checks_performed.check: Summary/takeaway truncation (missing terminal punctuation, very short text)
Speaker names vs programme speakers and across items
Lexical support of limitations/future_work/recommendations/results in the item transcript segments
checks_performed.detail: The low-overlap entries were spot-checked against the transcript and all were supported. Only entries describing the presentation itself are flagged.

checks_performed.check: Unassigned segments >= 2 min mentioning discussion/questions reviewed for omitted substantive discussion

issues.description: None of the 15 recordings has a video_url (empty in every source recording object; program-data.js has no video links). video_url is null throughout the derived files.
issues.suggested_correction: Add published video URLs to derived/recordings.json and content_items.json once available.
issues.resolution: Added the 15 matching Vimeo team-library share links to source recording metadata, derived recordings, and all content items. Each title matches a room/day recording; the Vimeo library identifies the links as Unlisted and anyone with the link can view.

issues.description: FORUM 25 Sep: Pranav Jha's talk is marked not_presented because the chair said an unnamed speaker was sick and the talk does not appear in the recording. The identity of the absent speaker is inferred.

issues.resolution: Used the programme co-presenter Mikhail Podolskiy because the talk title is an exact match. The conflicting ASR rendering remains in identification_notes; this is a programme-based identification, not an audio confirmation.

issues.description: Closing discussion with medium identification confidence: essentially one extended audience comment. Most of the session's discussion is attached to Joe Miller's talk.

issues.description: Stored as a discussion, but its own notes say the slot contained brief acknowledgements, a mineralogy-extension update and a call to join standards review rather than extended debate.

issues.resolution: Reviewed the 4:13 closing segment. It contains substantive updates on the mineralogy extension and MIDS review from Ben Norton and Adam Mansur, so retaining the scheduled discussion item is justified.
